thread:
elena: Quick follow-up from PM-2910 incidents  we keep hitting a "slow tail" under sustained bursts. Need concrete owners + runnable artifacts so this doesn't recur. Proposal: prompt corpus, CI regression job, and a controlled stage drill.

mike: I can own the stage drill. Plan: 12m burst (50->700 qps), restart 25% kv-cache pods at T+7m, and validate no >2x p95 and error-rate <1%. I'll open INF-4727 and add scripts.

priya: I'll assemble the prompt corpus (INF-4728). Goal: 120 prompts sampled from incident dumps, tagged as "latency-check" or "semantic-check". CSV will include source incident id + validator_hint. ETA 5 days.

elena: And CI? we want nightly regressions against pinned models and a core set that runs on each deploy.

mike: I'll add a stage-only wrk script and put sample lua payloads in infra/tests/long_seq. Example entry in INF-4727 repro steps:
```
wrk -t8 -c300 -d12m --latency http://stage.redwood/api/v1/generate -s scripts/long_seq.lua
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/kv-cache --selector=zone!=zone-a --timeout=90s
```

priya: For latency-only prompts we'll avoid token equality. Validators will be prefix/regex/length ranges. For semantic prompts we'll include a short expected prefix or matcher. I'll mark ~30 as "core" for CI.

elena: I'll own the CI job integration. Ticket INF-4729: `ci/evals/incident-guard` nightly + per-deploy core checks. ETA 8 days. It will emit p95, mean, and per-prompt pass/fail.

mike: I'll also add monitoring hooks to collect per-host kv-miss and a Console tile for p95/error/kv-miss.

priya: PR for the CSV will include columns: prompt_id, category, source_incident, validator_hint, ci_flag. Will attach a 20-sample artifact to the ticket.

elena: Please link these INF tickets to PM-2910 and add a "repro steps" snippet and at least one runnable artifact. Review gating: ticket must include script + sample data + dashboard hooks.

mike: linking now and scheduling the first controlled drill in two weeks.
